summary: Frontend verification of 3 features: Logo Yükleme (Settings > Hotel Logo PDF), Tatil Önizleme (holiday teal bands on Rate Calendar), and Etki Arşivi (executive PDF endpoint). All three features work end-to-end.

logo_upload.post_upload: toast 'Logo yüklendi (0.1KB) — tüm PDF raporlarında kullanılacak'; preview visible; branding-delete-btn (Kaldır) visible; 'Logoyu Değiştir' button visible
logo_upload.post_delete: preview text back to 'Logo yüklenmedi'; GET /api/branding/logo/default -> 404 (clean state restored)

tatil_onizleme.route: Revenue management (revenue-btn) -> Rate Calendar tab -> navigate next once from Aug 2026 to Sept 2026
tatil_onizleme.rev-cal-holiday-10: present, text '🎌 Jeûne genevois', bgcolor rgba(20,184,166,0.9) (teal-500)
tatil_onizleme.rev-cal-holiday-20: present, 'Eidgenössischer Dank-, Buss- und Bettag' (bonus – matches CH holiday list)
tatil_onizleme.note: Requires branch = Franziskaner (property 'default', country CH). On 'All Branches' (pid=all) holidays API returns GB set (no Sept dates) — expected.

etki_arsivi_light.GET /api/pms-connect/executive-pdf/defau: 200 application/pdf, ~2966 bytes, valid PDF magic bytes

regression.rate_calendar_day_click: click rev-cal-day-15 → input focused; Escape → input closes (works)
regression.settings_currencies: Currencies section renders with GBP/EUR/USD/TRY rows and +Add button

critical_code_review_comments: Property selector shadcn <Select> uses data-testid='property-selector' on component wrapper but the attribute is not forwarded to the rendered trigger DOM node — makes automated branch switching fragile (had to fallback to text locator 'All Branches'). Consider forwarding data-testid to SelectTrigger.

RateCalendarEditable in RevenuePanel receives pid='all' when 'All Branches' is selected; holidays API for 'all' returns GB (Summer Bank Holiday only). Not a bug, but users on multi-branch view will not see Swiss/property-specific holidays until they pick a branch. Optionally show a hint.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded temporary 73-byte test PNG for property 'default'; deleted after verification (GET returns 404).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach Rate Calendar with Swiss holidays, first switch top-left branch dropdown from 'All Branches' to 'Franziskaner by Centra' (options are role=option). Rev-mgmt panel opens a tour overlay data-testid='revenue-robot-tour' — remove via DOM before clicking rev-cal-next. Dismiss localStorage keys rateCalendarTourDone/revenueRobotTourDone. Current month defaults to Aug 2026 (today is 2026-08-15/16); one rev-cal-next click reaches September 2026.
